features.Boss: Ylt can take both a fast turn and a slow turn each round. After an enemy finishes a turn, Ylt can spend 1 focus to immediately use an extra action or free action. Additionally, he can spend 1 focus on his turn to remove a condition from himself
features.Flowing Earth: After Ylt uses the Cohesion surge, he can immediately use Vaulting Stone on himself (no action or Investiture required), but it doesn’t grant an advantage on his next attack.
features.Taln’s Honorblade: Ylt is bonded to the Honorblade of the Herald Taln. If he loses the weapon, he can summon it as an action, and it reappears in his hand at the start of his next fast turn. While not wielding it, he can’t use the Cohesion and Tension surges (including Vaulting Stone, Stone Spear, and Tension Parry).

Stone Spear.Description: Ylt can spend an Opportunity to knock the target Prone

Illusory Flourish.AOE: One target he has hit with a melee attack on his last turn
Illusory Flourish.Saving Throw: Illumination test against their Spiritual defense. On a success, the target is Disoriented.

Odious Vision.Description: Ylt surrounds himself with a vision in which he glows with golden Illumination. Regain 1d4 focus.

Vaulting Stone.Description: Ylt uses Cohesion to create a pillar of stone that propels him or a willing character within 15 feet of him into the air. That character lands in a space up to 15 feet away without triggering Reactive Strikes, and if their next action on this turn is a melee attack, that attack gains an advantage.

Regenerate.Description: Ylt recovers 4 health. He can use this free action even while Unconscious or otherwise prevented from using actions.

Tension Parry.Description: Before Ylt is hit or grazed by an attack against Physical defense, he can infuse Tension into his clothing to increase his Physical defense by 2 until the start of his next turn, including against the triggering attack. If the attack hit, this increase can change it into a miss, and if the attack grazed, he ignores its effects.
